witness_description: No witness found. The claim's finitely-checkable content is the Gale-Shapley invariant that a woman who has never received an offer is unmatched, and that an unmatched woman accepts a proposal. No violation exists anywhere in the swept space.
refutation_explanation: The claim is a step in a man-proposing deferred-acceptance execution: a man becomes free and proposes to Wn, who has received no offers, is therefore unmatched, and accepts. The record does not supply the specific worst-case instance construction defining Wn, so the exact scenario cannot be reconstructed; the refutable content is the underlying algorithm invariant, which was tested exhaustively and never violated: in every explored execution step of every instance, a woman with zero offers received so far was unmatched, and every unmatched woman who received a proposal accepted it (women only become matched via offers, so the invariant holds structurally).
search_space: All stable-matching instances with n in {1,2,3}: every combination of complete strict preference lists for all n men and all n women, 46673 instances total ((n!)^(2n) per n). For n<=2, ALL nondeterministic proposal schedules were explored by DFS over which free man proposes next; for n=3, the lowest-index-free-man and highest-index-free-man deterministic schedules were run. At every proposal event, invariant (A) 'zero offers so far implies unmatched' and invariant (B) 'unmatched woman accepts' were checked with exact integer arithmetic. Deterministic run, 0.37 s.
